basics.name: Luca Zulian
basics.label: Staff Engineer
basics.summary: Staff Engineer with 18+ years of experience in software, focused on designing and delivering scalable, high-availability distributed systems and backend services. Deep expertise in functional programming with hands-on experience in Elixir, Rust, Python, Haskell, and more. Specialised in microservices architecture, event-driven systems (CQRS/Event Sourcing), real-time data pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS. Experienced in integrating AI and large language models (LLMs) into production applications. Strong advocate for open-source software, CI/CD, observability, and engineering best practices including continuous delivery, defensive programming, and automated testing. Passionate about compilers, interpreters, domain-specific languages (DSLs), virtual machines, and autonomous systems.

projects.name: SlashFeed
projects.description: Designed and built a full-featured RSS/Atom feed reader from scratch, documented publicly via a build-in-public blog. Born as an experiment to test LLMs and agents in the context of a real SaaS. Features a reliable feed-fetching pipeline (Oban workers, RabbitMQ, ETag/Last-Modified conditional fetching), full-text search with PostgreSQL `pg_trgm`, AI summarisation via local LLM inference (Ollama), per-user MCP endpoints for LLM clients (Claude, Cursor, Zed), OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect server (`boruta_auth`), WebAuthn/passkey authentication (`wax_`), newsletter inboxes, podcast support, reading statistics, and a Progressive Web App.
